introduction: Mississippi CCPP helps eligible families pay participating child-care providers. Applications and certificate availability are separate questions.
description: Mississippi CCPP helps eligible families pay participating child-care providers. Applications and certificate availability are separate questions.

sections.who: Income and approved work, education or training requirements apply. Special categories and funding restrictions can affect intake.
sections.get: An approved certificate pays a participating provider; the parent’s monthly copayment depends on family size and income.
sections.docs:
• Child age, relationship and residency proof.
  • Recent income and activity records.
  • Requested parent identity documents.
sections.apply:
1. Choose a provider first

    Use MDHS’s CCPP application instructions and select a provider accepting MDHS subsidies.

  2. Apply and upload proof

    Follow the Apply Now route and supporting-document checklist.

  3. Confirm availability

    Ask 800-877-7882 whether your category is receiving certificates or awaiting funding.
sections.after: Check application status and respond to redetermination requests. Acceptance of an application does not guarantee immediate placement.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using CCPP application and proof; CCPP current parent updates. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Must I select a provider first?
Can any provider receive the subsidy?
No. Eligibility and availability must be confirmed.
